title: 长按选择
summary: 列表中这一按，是直接打开还是激活批量选择？单击默认打开；按住超 480ms 且位移在容差内激活选择模式；滑动则立即注销长按转为滚动。
summaryEn: Is this press in a list an immediate open or activating multi-selection? Tap opens; hold past 480ms within drift threshold enters select mode; drag cancels immediately for scroll.
asks: 列表中这一按，是直接打开还是激活批量选择？
asksEn: Does this press in a list open the item, or activate multi-select mode?
